caseName: Gulf, Mobile & Northern R. v. Helvering
caseNameFull: Gulf, Mobile & Northern R. Co. v. Helvering, Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. George E. H. Goodner for petitioner. Solicitor General Biggs, Assistant Attorney General Wideman, and Messrs. James W. Morris and Morton K. Rothschild for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia granted limited to the question of the right of the taxpayer to deductions on account of amortization of bond discount.
